request.project_task: Build a personal data export request workflow.
request.project_goal: Fulfil verified export requests within a controlled process.
request.project_description: A user requests an export, verifies identity, and downloads a time-limited archive assembled from multiple services.

use_cases.name: Request Personal Data Export
use_cases.goal: Allow a verified data subject to request an export of their personal data and receive a time-limited download notification.
use_cases.trigger: Data subject initiates an export request.

preconditions.text: The data subject is authenticated to the system.

success_postconditions.text: An encrypted archive containing data from available source services has been created and a time-limited download notification has been sent to the data subject.

failure_postconditions.text: The export request is rejected or fails, and no archive is made available for download.

main_success_scenario.name: Successful export request with recent identity verification

steps.expected_result: Data from available source services is collected.

steps.expected_result: Unavailable sources are recorded and included in the export metadata.

steps.expected_result: Data subject receives a notification with a time-limited download link.

steps.action: System checks that the data subject has recent identity verification.
steps.expected_result: Recent identity verification is not confirmed.

user_stories.capability: request an export of my personal data
user_stories.benefit: I can obtain a copy of my data held by the system

system_stories.system_action: Verify recent identity verification before processing the export request.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure only recently verified data subjects can request exports.

system_stories.system_action: Collect data from registered source services and record unavailable sources.
system_stories.responsibility: Assemble export data while transparently recording any unavailable sources.

system_stories.system_action: Create an encrypted archive and send a time-limited download notification.
system_stories.responsibility: Securely package the export and notify the data subject with a time-limited link.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Request Personal Data Export
Goal: Allow a verified data subject to request an export of their personal data and receive a time-limited download notification.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Data subject initiates an export request.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The data subject is authenticated to the system.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Data subject requests an export of personal data.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] System checks that the data subject has recent identity verification.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System collects data from registered source services.
  4. [STEP-UC001-004] System records any unavailable sources without silently omitting them.
  5. [STEP-UC001-005] System creates an encrypted archive.
  6. [STEP-UC001-006] System sends a time-limited download notification.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Identity verification is not recent
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006

use_cases.name: Download Personal Data Archive
use_cases.goal: Allow a data subject to download their encrypted export archive after re-authentication, with the archive deleted after expiry.
use_cases.trigger: Data subject follows the time-limited download link from the notification.

preconditions.text: An encrypted archive has been created and a time-limited download notification has been sent.
The download link has not expired.

success_postconditions.text: The data subject has downloaded the archive after re-authentication.

failure_postconditions.text: The download fails or the link has expired, and the archive is deleted after expiry.

steps.action: Data subject opens the time-limited download link.
Data subject attempts to use an expired download link.
steps.expected_result: System denies access because the link has expired.

steps.action: System deletes the archive after expiry.
steps.expected_result: The archive is deleted and no longer available.

user_stories.capability: download my personal data archive after re-authentication
user_stories.benefit: I can securely obtain my exported data within the allowed time window

system_stories.system_action: Require re-authentication before allowing archive download.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure only the intended data subject can download the archive.
Enforce time-limited availability of the archive.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Download Personal Data Archive
Goal: Allow a data subject to download their encrypted export archive after re-authentication, with the archive deleted after expiry.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Data subject follows the time-limited download link from the notification.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: An encrypted archive has been created and a time-limited download notification has been sent.
  - PRE-UC002-002: The download link has not expired.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Data subject opens the time-limited download link.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] Data subject re-authenticates.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] Data subject downloads the archive.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Download link has expired
Source FRs: FR-007, FR-008

issues.message: Step STEP-UC002-001 references FRs outside UC-002: FR-006
Step STEP-UC002-004 references FRs outside UC-002: FR-006

In UC-001 main scenario, steps 2, 3, and 6 assign actor_id to secondary actors (ACT-002, ACT-003, ACT-004) while the action text describes the System performing the action. This is a modeling/wording inconsistency, not a direct FR contradiction, so it is non-blocking.

UC-002 failure postcondition POST-UC002-002 states the archive is deleted after expiry, which is a normal lifecycle outcome rather than a failure outcome. This is a wording/decomposition concern and does not contradict FR-008, so it is non-blocking.
